correctness.rationale: Every consecutive triple weight changes by -1,0 or 1, giving necessity. Explicit base words 0001,0011,00011,000111 and independent endpoint extension cycles 100, 011 or 001 realize every positive interval histogram. Positive-composition counting proves the cubic and deficit formulas. Any h>=4 counterexample would require both h consecutive zeros and h consecutive ones in 2h+1 positions, and the sole extra bit duplicates only a level in {0,1,h-1,h}, never level 2. Standalone independent DP, brute enumeration, and witness checks confirm finite samples without substituting for proof.

originality.rationale: The new core is the exact iff characterization of feasible unordered length-three binary composition read multispectra, an explicit witness for every permitted vector, and a sharp counterexample for ALL widths >=4. Primary full-text discussions involve either literal fixed-length reads, all-length substring composition multisets, or ordered local histograms. Exact OEIS A188554 numeric coincidence is disclosed, and no novelty is claimed for the pre-existing cubic sequence. Search of published related research records found no statement implying the realizability equivalence or all-width sharp obstruction. A less-indexed equivalent realization theorem remains possible.
residual_risks: The same numeric cubic sequence was published separately as OEIS A188554; it must never be marketed as a new sequence.

value.rationale: Noiseless composition-only read streams are a natural finite-alphabet reconstruction channel. This theorem completely classifies every attainable output and gives an optimal zero-error codebook of exact size at all source lengths, not merely small enumerations. It also pinpoints the sharp read-width cutoff at which the simple realizability criterion fails, so it supplies a structurally motivated boundary absent from the known numerical OEIS family.
